text: settle the campaign: seasons stay manual until panel tooling lands

operator directive: add a permanent usefulness self-check - every 10 seasons a DIFFERENT model audits whether the loop is doing something useful; verdict + residuals land in akar and arm candidates (source: operator message 2026-09-15, after the PARTIALLY USEFUL verdict)

operator directive: plugin and hub architecture confirmed (all three design points agreed) - packs carry priors/ only (general knowledge: templates, prompts, lint profile, routes, patterns), campaign/ content never installs or publishes; rumpun plugin distill drafts priors from proven seasons; rumpun plugin lint rejects sids, absolute paths, and private-vocabulary matches at publish; hub v1 is git-based sharing (pack = repo, publish = push, install = pull + digest verify), hosted registry is a future product; first pack: kaggle-base distilled from this campaign's proven gates and patterns

operator confirmation: rename the component vocabulary to English - benih to writers, musim/ to seasons/, akar/ to ledger/ with the akar: citation prefix to ledger:, rimba/ to runs/; rumpun stays as the name; back-compat aliases resolve old names for the historical seasons; a glossary maps old to new; one dedicated season (s45) after the plugin boundary lands

finish the English rename: benih -> agents in the season yaml schema (lint, engine, prompts, back-compat read of old yamls), tuai out of the harvest help, musim/rimba message strings to English; s45 covered paths and docs only

operator approval 2026-09-16: epic rollup approved - seasons group into epics as DATA (a declaration file + rollup views); records stay append-only and byte-identical, no merging or rewriting of ledger history; payoff: bounded resume context and arc-level usefulness audits

operator directive 2026-09-16: track the .rumpun structure itself - a schema version for the campaign layout (season yaml, ledger record format, epics, registry) recorded per campaign, a versioned changelog of every structural change, and reader behavior for unknown versions (refuse or migrate explicitly) - self-evolution must not break its own history

operator directive 2026-09-16: a kanban view of campaign state - columns backlog (armed candidates + unfilled seeds), doing (the running season), need-human (unset cap, waiver requests, autonomy promotion), done (harvested seasons with verdict + salvage marks) - rendered by a verb (rumpun kanban) from the ledger and runs state, no new state file
kanban card format addendum: every NEED HUMAN card carries four plain sentences - what happened, what needs doing, why it needs a human, and what happens if nobody acts; no card ships without them

operator directive 2026-09-16: no cost cap for rumpun - the campaign runs until there is no more useful thing to do; usefulness exhaustion (as judged by the decadal audits and the operator) is the stopping criterion, not money

operator directive 2026-09-16: preinstall the i-have-adhd skill for anyone using rumpun - rumpun init installs/configures it (source: github.com/ayghri/i-have-adhd INSTALL.md), so every operator reads rumpun's output in adhd-actionable shape by default

operator correction 2026-09-16: the kancil route installs kancil from pip (the published package), not the local ../kancil source tree - the route invokes the installed kancil CLI; the s67 brief's local-path inspection is superseded

operator directive 2026-09-16: the first pack is kancil-base (not kaggle-base) - the pack serves kancil-driven campaigns of any domain; kaggle specifics fold in as content sections, and a venue-specific pack can later declare base: kancil-base lineage

operator directive 2026-09-16: rumpun improves kancil itself - seasons propose kancil improvements from usage evidence, file GitHub issues, land PRs, merge them, then update the pip-installed kancil package; the forge flow (issue -> PR -> merge -> update) is the delivery path

operator directive 2026-09-16: rumpun uses its own GitHub projects as the cross-machine kanban - an instance on any machine or project files feature/bug issues into a GitHub Project board when it identifies work, and any rumpun instance can check the board, pick an issue, and resolve it as season scope; prerequisite recorded: the campaign repo has no git remote today, so the rumpun repo (under khursani8/khursanirevo) and its Project must be created first

operator directive 2026-09-17: kancil is used as a plugin, so rumpun needs a proper skills prompt for writers when the kancil route activates - built from a full read of the kancil source (the CLI surface, the stop-sentinel contract, the workflow verbs), aligned to the kancil version it was generated from, with the version tracked so users on other kancil versions get a detected mismatch instead of a silently wrong prompt

operator directive 2026-09-18: resolve all github issues - the six open issues (#5, #11, #12, #14, #15, #16) each receive their honest resolution: #5 closed as delivered (the standing standard held at every closure since s80), #11/#12 closed as documented (the credit exhaustion recorded; the refill named in RESUME resume triggers), #14 closed as demonstrated (the khursani campaign external use), #15/#16 closed as designed-and-first-sliced (the contracts in the pack, the slices measured)

auto-continue standing directive from operator 2026-09-20: after every season close, seed, fill, and launch the next season immediately without waiting for a go; the loop only stops on an explicit stop word from the operator or a real blocker; report each close in one line and keep going
